Unfortunately, in my case, the outcome was not good and my teeth were negatively affected. The only nice thing I can say about this place is that the waiting room in their Google profile looks good in photos… your procedure room is a third of that size, by the way, and claustrophobically tiny. The nice photos in their Google profile don’t make up for the poor quality of care, so I advise you to stay away.

I was charged $100 for a 15-minute routine teeth cleaning. This pricing is not listed anywhere online, which is why I’m stating it here so others know what to expect.

During that short appointment, the dentist removed my existing dental bonding on my lower front teeth without telling me or asking for consent. When I looked in the mirror afterward, there was a clear gap where bonding had been placed before for cosmetic reasons.

When I questioned it, I was told it was “just plaque,” which made no sense. I even showed photos of my teeth from before the appointment and right after, clearly showing that bonding was gone. It was still denied.

Please don’t respond to this review with a generic “contact us to discuss.” I already brought this up in person and it was dismissed. I had to go to a different dentist the very next day to fix the gap that was created.

This was upsetting, expensive, and completely unacceptable. I’m posting this so others know the pricing and what they may be risking by coming here.
